metadata.title: ExitProcessRequest
metadata.description: The Show-ExitProcessRequest function displays a form that requests the user to save and close a specified process. You may specify just a display name but if you include a process name then it will attempt to terminate that process at the end. The function allows the user to continue or optionally permit them to cancel the process closure, if no process name is specified it will simply return an error. If the user has not clicked Continue within the specified time limit, if a process name was specified then it is forcibly closed. You can specify a "display name" that is referenced in the message (i.e. Calculator instead of calc.exe), allow the user to cancel if desired, specify the time limit, and specify the icon to display in the message box.
